config.trace: step idx at every guarded inversion + chunk gcd check, normalized by closed-form data-independent total steps

honest_notes: KS p-values use the asymptotic Kolmogorov series (n>=2); fine at these n.
Pre-registered 17% baseline is PER-CURVE while exp568's 68% was a 3-curve CELL rate; both comparisons reported (H2_primary literal, H2_percurve calibrated), verdict read jointly.
Collision baseline treats inversion denominators as independent uniform mod p; chunk-batched gcd checks are counted as steps in the trace.
found_q events are pure q-side collision luck (B1<p<<q, order-completion impossible); they cross-check the collision rate independently.

Trace denominator is schedule-only (data-independent); ec_add's rare recursive internal double (den==0 mod N & y1==y2) executes without an idx increment -- a tiny data-dependent bias on found_at indices only.
Step-counter law verified: first chunk does len-1 doubles / popcount-1 adds, later chunks len doubles / popcount adds (caught + fixed vs closed form before full run; smoke norms were misnormalized).
'deaths' (gcd==N) collapse curves silently inside trial(); their count is not separately bucketed (inherited exp568 behavior).
